points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers and amounts read correctly, with the currency beside the right figure?
Does the line with +966 55 123 4567 keep the number whole and in order?
Do the six code boxes fill in from the right?
Is the countdown "0:45" readable and in the right order?
Is the verify button easy to spot and tap?
Are the title and the sent-code line centred or aligned to the right edge?
Is the spacing between the six boxes even?
